readerCopy.body: An opportunity can touch the exact place where you still doubt yourself and still be worth taking. When Chiron conjuncts the North Node, a new opportunity may resemble an earlier experience that left you embarrassed, rejected, overlooked, or convinced you were not ready. Teaching after being embarrassed, applying after rejection, leading after being ignored, or returning to something you once struggled with can bring the history directly into the present. You do not need to feel completely healed before you use what you learned. Let the old experience inform the decision without letting it make the decision for you.
